  1177	def instrument_evidence(
  1178	    detection: FiducialDetection,
  1179	    *,
  1180	    bindings: Mapping[str, Any],
  1181	    validation_id: str,
  1182	    artifact_sha256: Mapping[str, str],
  1183	    protocol_pulse_count: int = PULSE_COUNT,
  1184	    protocol_id: str = PROTOCOL_ID,
  1185	    capture_wall_time_s: float | None = None,
  1186	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1187	    """Assemble ``instrument_evidence.json`` content, failing closed.
  1188	
  1189	    ``bindings`` must supply every :data:`BINDING_FIELDS` entry non-empty;
  1190	    production bundles reference the result by sha256, and any bound-field
  1191	    change invalidates the calibration. Every protocol binds ALL
  1192	    ``protocol_pulse_count`` pulses detected: a run with a fitted bound but
  1193	    fewer than the protocol count (or any undetected pulse) is ``invalid``.
  1194	    """
  1195	
  1196	    if protocol_id not in SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_IDS:
  1197	        raise ValueError(f"unsupported fiducial protocol: {protocol_id!r}")
  1198	    binding_fields = (
  1199	        V2_BINDING_FIELDS
  1200	        if protocol_id in {PROTOCOL_V2_ID, PROTOCOL_ID}
  1201	        else LEGACY_BINDING_FIELDS
  1202	    )

  1318	def run_matmul_pulse(duration_s: float, buffers: Any = None) -> int:
  1319	    """Drive one GPU pulse of preallocated FP16 MLX matmuls with fencing.
  1320	
  1321	    Returns the number of fenced matmuls issued. Requires ``mlx`` (live
  1322	    [QUIET-MAC] runs only; never imported at module load so CI stays pure).
  1323	    """
  1324	
  1325	    import time
  1326	
  1327	    import mlx.core as mx  # noqa: PLC0415 - live-run-only dependency
  1328	
  1329	    if buffers is None:
  1330	        buffers = allocate_matmul_buffers()
  1331	    left, right = buffers
  1332	    issued = 0
  1333	    deadline = time.monotonic() + duration_s
  1334	    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
  1335	        product = mx.matmul(left, right)
  1336	        mx.eval(product)  # GPU fence: the pulse edge stays honest
  1337	        issued += 1
  1338	    return issued
  1339	
  1340	
  1341	def allocate_matmul_buffers() -> tuple[Any, Any]:
  1342	    """Preallocate the pulse workload buffers (outside any pulse window)."""
  1343	
  1344	    import mlx.core as mx  # noqa: PLC0415 - live-run-only dependency
  1345	
  1346	    left = mx.random.normal((MATRIX_SIDE, MATRIX_SIDE)).astype(mx.float16)
  1347	    right = mx.random.normal((MATRIX_SIDE, MATRIX_SIDE)).astype(mx.float16)
  1348	    mx.eval(left, right)
  1349	    return left, right

   149	
   150	def _interpolate(curve: list[TracePoint], t: float) -> float:
   151	    """Return the curve value at ``t`` (linear between samples, clamped past
   152	    the first/last sample)."""
   153	    if t <= curve[0].t:
   154	        return curve[0].power_w
   155	    if t >= curve[-1].t:
   156	        return curve[-1].power_w
   157	    # Binary-free linear scan is fine: traces are small (seconds * Hz).
   158	    for left, right in zip(curve, curve[1:]):
   159	        if left.t <= t <= right.t:
   160	            if right.t == left.t:
   161	                return left.power_w
   162	            frac = (t - left.t) / (right.t - left.t)
   163	            return left.power_w + frac * (right.power_w - left.power_w)
   164	    return curve[-1].power_w  # pragma: no cover - covered by the clamps above
   165	
   166	
   167	def _integrate(curve: list[TracePoint], start_s: float, end_s: float) -> float:
   168	    """Integrate a point curve or a WO-005 interval-average trace."""
   169	    if end_s <= start_s:
   170	        return 0.0
   171	    if curve and curve[0].support_start_s is not None:
   172	        return math.fsum(
   173	            point.power_w
   174	            * max(
   175	                0.0,
   176	                min(end_s, point.support_end_s or point.t)
   177	                - max(start_s, point.support_start_s),
   178	            )
   179	            for point in curve
   180	        )
   181	    # Build the integration knots: the two window edges plus every interior
   182	    # sample strictly inside the window, in time order.
   183	    knots: list[float] = [start_s]
   184	    for point in curve:
   185	        if start_s < point.t < end_s:
   186	            knots.append(point.t)
   187	    knots.append(end_s)
   188	    total = 0.0
   189	    for left_t, right_t in zip(knots, knots[1:]):
   190	        left_p = _interpolate(curve, left_t)
   191	        right_p = _interpolate(curve, right_t)
   192	        total += 0.5 * (left_p + right_p) * (right_t - left_t)
   193	    return total
   194	
   195	
   196	def _in_window_sample_count(curve: list[TracePoint], window: Window) -> int:
   197	    if curve and curve[0].support_start_s is not None:
   198	        return sum(
   199	            1
   200	            for point in curve
   201	            if point.support_start_s is not None
   202	            and point.support_end_s is not None
   203	            and min(window.end_s, point.support_end_s)
   204	            > max(window.start_s, point.support_start_s)
   205	        )
   206	    return sum(1 for point in curve if window.start_s <= point.t <= window.end_s)

   431	        """Power curve for one persisted event-v2 source identity."""

   433	        key = f"source_curve:{source_identity}"

   436	                row
   437	                for row in self.trace_rows()

   441	                {
   442	                    row["rail"]

   455	                TracePoint(
   456	                    t=t,
   457	                    power_w=trace.totals[t],
   458	                    support_start_s=(

   460	                    ),

   487	    def measured_window(self) -> Window | None:
   488	        """The window the reducer integrates over (D-026).
   489	
   490	        Preferred bounds are the ``sampling_started``/``sampling_stopped``
   491	        marker events (sampling confirmed active, so sampler spawn latency and
   492	        stop-side parsing stay outside the window). Bundles written before the
   493	        markers existed (pre-2N.2) fall back to the ``measured_run`` stage
   494	        boundaries.
   495	        """
   496	        marker_start: float | None = None
   497	        marker_end: float | None = None
   498	        stage_start: float | None = None
   499	        stage_end: float | None = None
   500	        for event in self.events():
   501	            if event.get("phase") != "measured_run":
   502	                continue
   503	            event_type = event.get("event_type")
   504	            if event_type == "sampling_started":
   505	                marker_start = float(event["timestamp_s"])
   506	            elif event_type == "sampling_stopped":
   507	                marker_end = float(event["timestamp_s"])
   508	            elif event_type == "stage_started":
   509	                stage_start = float(event["timestamp_s"])
   510	            elif event_type == "stage_completed":
   511	                stage_end = float(event["timestamp_s"])
   512	        if marker_start is not None and marker_end is not None:
   513	            return Window(start_s=marker_start, end_s=marker_end)
   514	        if stage_start is None or stage_end is None:
   515	            return None
   516	        return Window(start_s=stage_start, end_s=stage_end)
   517	
   518	    def runtime_cleanup_ok(self) -> bool | None:
   519	        """Local runtime-cleanup result from cleanup completion events.
   520	
   521	        A recorded ``False`` dominates because one failed cleanup is enough to
   522	        contaminate the following repetition. Otherwise every matching value
   523	        must be the boolean ``True``; absent or malformed evidence is unknown.
   524	        """
   525	        values: list[Any] = []
   526	        for event in self.events():
   527	            if (
   528	                event.get("event_type") != "stage_completed"
   529	                or event.get("phase") != "cleanup"
   530	            ):
   531	                continue
   532	            metadata = event.get("metadata")
   533	            if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
   534	                values.append(None)
   535	                continue
   536	            values.append(metadata.get("cleanup_ok"))
   537	        if any(value is False for value in values):
   538	            return False
   539	        if not values or any(not isinstance(value, bool) for value in values):
   540	            return None
   541	        return True
   542	
   543	    def phase_windows(self) -> dict[str, list[Window]]:
   544	        """Return validated ``phase_start``/``phase_end`` windows.
   545	
   546	        Pairing is scoped by phase plus power-source identity. Every marker
   547	        must pair, intervals must not reverse, and intervals attributed to one
   548	        source must not overlap. Concurrent intervals on distinct identified
   549	        nodes, each representing its own meter, are valid. Multiple valid
   550	        intervals with the same phase name are integrated separately and
   551	        summed by the reducer.
   552	        """
   553	        return self._validated_phase_pairing().windows_by_phase
   554	
   555	    def token_timestamps(self) -> list[float]:
   556	        """Output/decode token timestamps only.
   557	
   558	        Token events on the prompt side are not a valid denominator for
   559	        output-token metrics. The event contract's discriminator is the
   560	        event's phase: current runtimes emit output tokens in ``decode``.
   561	        When decode phase windows are present, the timestamp must also land
   562	        inside one of those windows.
   563	        """
   564	        pairing = self._validated_phase_pairing()
   565	        return [
   566	            float(event["timestamp_s"])
   567	            for event in self.events()
   568	            if _is_decode_token_event(event, pairing)
   569	        ]

   571	    def suite_manifest(self) -> SuiteManifest | None:
   572	        """Strict suite manifest accessor.
   573	
   574	        Returns ``None`` when ``suite_manifest.json`` is absent. If the file
   575	        exists, it must parse and validate as a :class:`SuiteManifest`.
   576	        Legacy v1 reads synthesize the v2 cache verification marker; the exact
   577	        synthesized field name is exposed in ``manifest.synthesized_fields``
   578	        so consumers cannot mistake compatibility interpretation for bytes
   579	        that were present in the historical artifact.

   582	            if not (self._path / "suite_manifest.json").is_file():
   583	                self._cache["suite_manifest"] = None
   584	            else:
   585	                raw = self._strict_json("suite_manifest.json")
   586	                try:

   588	                except SchemaError as exc:

   590	                        f"suite_manifest.json does not re-validate: {exc}"
   591	                    ) from exc

   595	        """Return suite item outcomes in realized execution order.

   597	        These existing per-item records are the realized-output evidence of
   598	        record for both current and sealed suite bundles.  The bundle-level
   599	        ``output_policy.stop_condition`` is intentionally not interpreted as

   608	    def suite_window(self) -> Window | None:
   609	        """FIFO-pair the first ``suite_start``/``suite_end`` marker."""
   610	        starts: list[float] = []
   611	        for event in self.events():
   612	            event_type = event.get("event_type")
   613	            if event_type == SUITE_START:
   614	                starts.append(float(event["timestamp_s"]))
   615	            elif event_type == SUITE_END and starts:
   616	                return Window(start_s=starts.pop(0), end_s=float(event["timestamp_s"]))
   617	        return None

  2249	            gap_s = idle_start_s - float(preceding_end_s)

  2370	    def _flush_events(self) -> None:
  2371	        """Append every buffered event to ``events.jsonl`` exactly once.
  2372	
  2373	        Called by ``_stage_reduce`` before the reducer runs (so the reducer
  2374	        reads a populated log, D-002) and again by ``_finish`` so the failure
  2375	        paths - which never reach ``_stage_reduce`` - flush before finalize. A
  2376	        repeat call appends only events buffered since the previous flush (e.g.
  2377	        the reduce ``stage_completed`` event, buffered after the in-reduce
  2378	        flush), so no event is written twice. Within each flushed batch a
  2379	        stable sort by timestamp keeps controller stage boundaries bracketing
  2380	        the runtime events they enclose; the trailing batch's events are
  2381	        strictly later than the first batch's, so global order is preserved.
  2382	        """
  2383	        pending = self._events[self._events_flushed_count :]
  2384	        for event in sorted(pending, key=lambda event: event.timestamp_s):
  2385	            self._writer.append_event(event)
  2386	        self._events_flushed_count = len(self._events)
  2387	
  2388	    def _finish(self) -> None:
  2389	        """Flush buffered logs and events, then finalize (D-011, D-013)."""
  2390	        self._flush_log("controller.log", self._controller_log)
  2391	        self._flush_log("runtime.log", self._runtime_log)
  2392	        self._flush_log("telemetry.log", self._telemetry_log)
  2393	        self._flush_events()
  2394	        self._writer.finalize()

  2396	    def _flush_log(self, name: str, records: list[str]) -> None:

  2398	        if records:
  2399	            path.write_text("".join(record + "\n" for record in records))
  2400	        else:
  2401	            path.write_text("no records\n")

  2405	# Cooldown gate (D-014: idle-power recovery between live repetitions)
  2406	
  2407	
  2408	def cooldown_gate(
  2409	    telemetry: TelemetryAdapter,
  2410	    reference_baseline: IdleBaseline,
  2411	    config: BenchmarkConfig,
  2412	    clock: Clock,
  2413	    run_id: str | None = None,
  2414	    policy: CooldownPolicy | None = None,
  2415	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  2416	    """Hold for a complete sustained cooldown-v2 recovery window.
  2417	
  2418	    Sub-window means are weighted by their evidenced durations over the most
  2419	    recent complete sustained window.  Release requires both a complete
  2420	    wall-clock span and the policy's minimum evidence coverage, so small probe
  2421	    gaps neither prevent recovery nor masquerade as a complete window.
  2422	    Recovery is one-sided: values below the reference count as recovered.
  2423	    Thermal pressure must be nominal at release, and an optional calibrated
  2424	    absolute ceiling is an additional upper cap, never an alternative escape.
  2425	
  2426	    All blocking is via ``telemetry.measure_idle`` (which sleeps on the clock),
  2427	    so a ``FakeClock`` makes the gate instant and exact in tests.
  2428	
  2429	    ``run_id`` (NV-2/ARC-7): the gate calls ``measure_idle`` out-of-run with
  2430	    no ``RunContext``, so adapters that need a run id for node-side isolation
  2431	    fall back to ``config.run_id`` - which is ``None`` for generated-id
  2432	    experiments. When given, ``run_id`` is stamped onto the sub-window config
  2433	    so those adapters see a cooldown-scoped id instead of failing.
  2434	    """
  2435	    selected = policy if policy is not None else CooldownPolicy()
  2436	    reference = reference_baseline.power_w_mean
  2437	    sub_config = replace(
  2438	        config,
  2439	        run_id=run_id if run_id is not None else config.run_id,
  2440	        sampling=replace(config.sampling, idle_seconds=selected.subwindow_s),
  2441	    )
  2442	    start_s = clock.now()
  2443	    readings: list[tuple[float, float, float, float]] = []
  2444	    trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2445	    while True:
  2446	        subwindow_start_s = clock.now()
  2447	        baseline = telemetry.measure_idle(sub_config)
  2448	        now_s = clock.now()
  2449	        duration_s = baseline.duration_s
  2450	        if not isinstance(duration_s, int | float) or duration_s <= 0.0:
  2451	            duration_s = max(0.0, now_s - subwindow_start_s)
  2452	        evidence_start_s = now_s - float(duration_s)
  2453	        # Do not let a backend-reported duration reach backward across the
  2454	        # actual start of this bounded capture.
  2455	        evidence_start_s = max(evidence_start_s, subwindow_start_s)
  2456	        readings.append(
  2457	            (subwindow_start_s, evidence_start_s, now_s, baseline.power_w_mean)
  2458	        )
  2459	        cutoff = now_s - selected.sustained_window_s
  2460	        readings = [reading for reading in readings if reading[2] > cutoff]
  2461	        weighted_sum = 0.0
  2462	        coverage_s = 0.0
  2463	        retained_start_s: float | None = None
  2464	        for capture_start, evidence_start, evidence_end, value in readings:
  2465	            clipped_start = max(evidence_start, cutoff)
  2466	            overlap_s = max(0.0, evidence_end - clipped_start)
  2467	            weighted_sum += overlap_s * value
  2468	            coverage_s += overlap_s
  2469	            if overlap_s > 0.0:
  2470	                retained_capture_start = max(capture_start, cutoff)
  2471	                retained_start_s = (
  2472	                    retained_capture_start
  2473	                    if retained_start_s is None
  2474	                    else min(retained_start_s, retained_capture_start)
  2475	                )
  2476	        rolling_mean = weighted_sum / coverage_s if coverage_s > 0.0 else None
  2477	        window_span_s = (
  2478	            max(0.0, now_s - retained_start_s)
  2479	            if retained_start_s is not None
  2480	            else 0.0
  2481	        )
  2482	        waited_s = now_s - start_s
  2483	        try:
  2484	            thermal = telemetry.thermal_state(sub_config)
  2485	            thermal_pressure = thermal.thermal_pressure
  2486	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unknown thermal fails the conjunctive gate
  2487	            thermal_pressure = None
  2488	        thermal_nominal = (
  2489	            isinstance(thermal_pressure, str)
  2490	            and thermal_pressure.lower() in {"nominal", "normal"}
  2491	        )
  2492	        reference_upper_w = reference * (1.0 + selected.tolerance_fraction)
  2493	        effective_upper_w = reference_upper_w
  2494	        if selected.absolute_ceiling_w is not None:
  2495	            effective_upper_w = min(effective_upper_w, selected.absolute_ceiling_w)
  2496	        required_coverage_s = (
  2497	            selected.coverage_fraction * selected.sustained_window_s
  2498	        )
  2499	        span_complete = window_span_s + 1e-9 >= selected.sustained_window_s
  2500	        coverage_complete = coverage_s + 1e-9 >= required_coverage_s

   163	    ) -> dict:

   170	    def idle_admission_records(
   171	        self,
   172	        *,
   173	        run_id: str,
   174	        attempt: int,
   175	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]] | None:
   176	        """Expose one just-captured idle window to live admission.
   177	
   178	        This is an in-memory controller seam: it does not replace or alter the
   179	        preserved raw/rich artifacts, and attempt selection is explicit so a
   180	        retry verdict cannot accidentally consume attempt-1 CPU telemetry.
   181	        """
   182	
   183	        records = self._idle_admission_records_by_run.get(run_id, {}).get(attempt)
   184	        if records is None:

   186	        return [dict(record) for record in records]

   188	    def promote_idle_admission_attempt(
   189	        self,
   190	        *,
   191	        run_id: str,
   192	        attempt: int,
   193	        context: RunContext,

   195	        """Make the final admitted retry the canonical idle artifact.
   196	
   197	        The fixed canonical name is the reducer interface.  Retry-specific
   198	        files remain immutable audit evidence; on the first retry promotion,
   199	        attempt 1 is preserved under its explicit audit name before the
   200	        canonical path is atomically replaced.

   202	
   203	        if attempt <= 1:

   642	    def _measured_anchor_lag_s(
   643	        self,
   644	        *,
   645	        sampling_started: ClockStamp,
   646	        sampling_stopped: ClockStamp,
   647	    ) -> float:

   654	        stamps = (
   655	            pre_spawn,
   656	            first_parse,
   657	            sampling_started,
   658	            sampling_stopped,
   659	            # Match the provisional drain anchor: the authoritative post-parse
   660	            # stamp does not exist until after sampler termination.
   661	            sampling_stopped,
   662	        )
   663	        values = (
   664	            value
   665	            for stamp in stamps
   666	            for value in (
   667	                stamp.epoch_s,
   668	                stamp.monotonic_before_s,
   669	                stamp.monotonic_after_s,

   673	        )
   674	        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):

   676	        if any(
   677	            stamp.monotonic_before_s > stamp.monotonic_after_s

   679	            or stamp.monotonic_resolution_s < 0.0

   684	        offset_lowers_s: list[float] = []
   685	        offset_uppers_s: list[float] = []
   686	        for stamp in stamps:

   688	                stamp.wall_resolution_s,
   689	                stamp.monotonic_resolution_s,
   690	            )
   691	            offset_lowers_s.append(
   692	                stamp.epoch_s - stamp.monotonic_after_s - resolution_s
   693	            )
   694	            offset_uppers_s.append(
   695	                stamp.epoch_s - stamp.monotonic_before_s + resolution_s
   696	            )

   698	            pre_spawn.monotonic_before_s + min(offset_lowers_s)
   699	        )
   700	        first_endpoint_upper_s = (
   701	            first_parse.monotonic_after_s + max(offset_uppers_s)
   702	        )
   703	        derived_lag_s = max(
   704	            0.0,
   705	            (first_endpoint_upper_s - first_endpoint_lower_s) / 2.0,
   706	        )

   708	            not math.isfinite(derived_lag_s)

   712	        return derived_lag_s

   714	    def _capture_brackets_stop(
   715	        self,
   716	        capture_path: Path,
   717	        *,

   720	        sampling_stopped: ClockStamp,

   726	            return False

   728	            return False
   729	        try:
   730	            data = capture_path.read_bytes()
   731	        except (OSError, ValueError):
   732	            return False

   734	            return False

   736	            native_records = parse_powermetrics_records(data)
   737	        except (OSError, ValueError):

   739	        if self._drain_monotonic() >= deadline:
   740	            return False

   742	            "sampling_started": sampling_started,
   743	            "sampling_stopped": sampling_stopped,
   744	            # The final evidence derivation still takes its post_parse stamp
   745	            # after termination. Reusing the stop stamp here is provisional
   746	            # and avoids changing the five-stamp evidence semantics.
   747	            "post_parse": sampling_stopped,
   748	        }
   749	        if self._pre_spawn_stamp is not None:
   750	            stamps["pre_spawn"] = self._pre_spawn_stamp
   751	        if self._first_parse_stamp is not None:
   752	            stamps["first_parse"] = self._first_parse_stamp
   753	        if self._drain_monotonic() >= deadline:
   754	            return False
   755	        evidence, point_anchor_s = derive_powermetrics_clock_evidence_v2(
   756	            stamps=stamps,
   757	            records=anchor_records_from_powermetrics(native_records),
   758	        )
   759	        if self._drain_monotonic() >= deadline:
   760	            return False
   761	        if point_anchor_s is None:
   762	            return False
   763	        # Project the wall-stamped stop marker into the reconstructed trace's
   764	        # relative timestamp domain under the EARLIEST allowed anchor, so the
   765	        # retained capture still brackets the stop marker at every admissible
   766	        # anchor shift. Comparing wall drain duration directly would stop
   767	        # early by the startup anchor lag.
   768	        earliest_anchor_s = float(
   769	            evidence["clock_anchor"]["admissible_lower_epoch_s"]

   771	        projected_stop_endpoint_s = (
   772	            sampling_stopped.epoch_s
   773	            + required_post_window_tail_s

   775	        )

   777	            not math.isfinite(projected_stop_endpoint_s)
   778	            or projected_stop_endpoint_s <= 0.0
   779	        ):
   780	            return False
   781	        relative_endpoint_s = 0.0
   782	        for index, record in enumerate(native_records):
   783	            if self._drain_monotonic() >= deadline:
   784	                return False
   785	            if index > 0:
   786	                relative_endpoint_s += record.elapsed_ns / 1_000_000_000.0
   787	            if relative_endpoint_s >= projected_stop_endpoint_s:
   788	                return True
   789	        return False

   361	class FloorEstimate:
   362	    """Full calculation record for one floor component."""
   363

   365	    n: int

   367	    deviations_j: tuple  # residuals (absolute) or block deltas (comparative)

   380	def small_sample_guard_factor(n: int) -> float:
   381	    """Frozen, accepted operational safety factor g(n) for n >= 5."""
   382	    if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int):
   383	        raise TypeError("n must be an int (bool rejected)")
   384	    if n < GUARD_MINIMUM_N:
   385	        raise ValueError(f"guard factor undefined below n={GUARD_MINIMUM_N} (smoke only)")
   386	    if n >= GUARD_REFERENCE_N:
   387	        return 1.0
   388	    return math.sqrt((GUARD_REFERENCE_N - 1) / (n - 1))
   389	
   390	
   391	def _clean_values(values_j: Sequence[float], label: str) -> list:
   392	    cleaned = []
   393	    for value in values_j:
   394	        if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
   395	            raise TypeError(f"{label} must be finite numbers")
   396	        value = float(value)
   397	        if not math.isfinite(value):
   398	            raise ValueError(f"{label} must be finite")
   399	        cleaned.append(value)
   400	    if len(cleaned) < 2:
   401	        raise ValueError(f"need at least 2 {label} for a sample standard deviation")
   402	    return cleaned
   403	
   404	
   405	def _floor_estimate(kind: str, deviations: Sequence[float], mean: float, prediction_extra: float) -> FloorEstimate:
   406	    n = len(deviations)
   407	    dev_mean = sum(deviations) / n
   408	    s = math.sqrt(sum((d - dev_mean) ** 2 for d in deviations) / (n - 1))
   409	    t_critical = student_t_critical_95(n - 1)
   410	    prediction = prediction_extra + t_critical * s * math.sqrt(1.0 + 1.0 / n)
   411	    max_abs = max(abs(d) for d in deviations)
   412	    unguarded = max(max_abs, prediction)
   413	    if n >= GUARD_MINIMUM_N:
   414	        guard: Optional[float] = small_sample_guard_factor(n)
   415	        guarded: Optional[float] = guard * unguarded
   416	    else:
   417	        # Smoke-only diagnostics: unguarded components emitted, floor is null.
   418	        guard = None
   419	        guarded = None
   420	    return FloorEstimate(
   421	        kind=kind,
   422	        n=n,
   423	        mean_j=mean,
   424	        deviations_j=tuple(deviations),
   425	        sample_stddev_j=s,
   426	        max_abs_deviation_j=max_abs,
   427	        t_critical=t_critical,
   428	        prediction_component_j=prediction,
   429	        unguarded_floor_j=unguarded,
   430	        guard_factor=guard,
   431	        guarded_floor_j=guarded,
   432	    )
   433

   435	def _admissible_widths(
   436	    widths_j: Sequence[float] | None, *, expected_n: int
   437	) -> list[float]:
   438	    if widths_j is None:
   439	        raise ValueError("admissible-set half-widths are required")

   441	    if len(widths) != expected_n:
   442	        raise ValueError("admissible-set half-width count must match point estimates")
   443	    if any(value < 0.0 for value in widths):
   444	        raise ValueError("admissible-set half-widths must be >= 0")
   445	    return widths

   461	def _apply_admissible_set_guard(

   465	) -> FloorEstimate:
   466	    """Raise a point-estimate floor to cover admitted energy sets.
   467	
   468	    The D-054 scatter calculation remains visible in its component fields, but
   469	    the operative unguarded/guarded floors can never be smaller than the
   470	    largest attainable magnitude of the linear residual/contrast. Otherwise a

   499	
   500	def _point_floor_diagnostic(estimate: FloorEstimate) -> dict[str, object]:
   501	    point_unguarded = max(
   502	        estimate.max_abs_deviation_j,
   503	        estimate.prediction_component_j,
   504	    )
   505	    point_guarded = (
   506	        estimate.guard_factor * point_unguarded
   507	        if estimate.guard_factor is not None
   508	        else None
   509	    )
   510	    return {
   511	        "label": "repeatability_diagnostic",
   512	        "published_claim_floor": False,
   513	        "unguarded_floor_j": point_unguarded,
   514	        "guard_factor": estimate.guard_factor,
   515	        "guarded_floor_j": point_guarded,
   516	    }

   519	def admissible_set_uncertainty_dominates_point_floor(
   520	    estimate: FloorEstimate,
   521	) -> bool:
   522	    """Classify the registered D-078 condition without turning it into refusal.
   523	
   524	    This reproduces the original terminal gate's exact comparison: the
   525	    largest linear residual/contrast admitted by the member anchor envelopes
   526	    is compared with the guarded point-only false-effect floor.  The complete
   527	    corner-maximized floor remains the published number.
   528	    """
   529	
   530	    widths = estimate.admissible_half_widths_j
   531	    if not widths or not any(widths):
   532	        return False
   533	    diagnostic = _point_floor_diagnostic(estimate)
   534	    point_gate = diagnostic["guarded_floor_j"]
   535	    if point_gate is None:
   536	        point_gate = diagnostic["unguarded_floor_j"]
   537	    if estimate.kind == "absolute":
   538	        n = estimate.n
   539	        width_sum = math.fsum(widths)
   540	        uncertainty_max = max(
   541	            abs(residual)
   542	            + width * (n - 1) / n
   543	            + (width_sum - width) / n
   544	            for residual, width in zip(
   545	                estimate.deviations_j, widths, strict=True
   546	            )
   547	        )
   548	    elif estimate.kind == "comparative":
   549	        uncertainty_max = _linear_corner_widened_max(
   550	            estimate.deviations_j, widths
   551	        )
   552	    else:
   553	        raise ValueError(f"unknown floor kind: {estimate.kind!r}")
   554	    return uncertainty_max > point_gate

   557	def _add_attribution_limit_metadata(
   558	    record: dict,
   559	    estimate: FloorEstimate,
   560	) -> dict:
   561	    if not admissible_set_uncertainty_dominates_point_floor(estimate):
   562	        return record
   563	    return {
   564	        **record,
   565	        "floor_source": ATTRIBUTION_FLOOR_SOURCE,
   566	        "floor_limit_class": ATTRIBUTION_LIMIT_CLASS,
   567	        "point_floor_diagnostic": _point_floor_diagnostic(estimate),
   568	        "single_count_discipline": attribution_single_count_discipline(),
   569	    }

   571	
   572	def _corner_maximized_unguarded_floor(
   573	    point_values_j: Sequence[float],
   574	    half_widths_j: Sequence[float],
   575	    *,
   576	    kind: str,
   577	) -> float:
   578	    """Return the exact full D-054 floor maximum over an interval box.
   579	
   580	    The maximum of the complete floor (maximum absolute term, sample
   581	    standard deviation, and Student-t prediction term) occurs at a vertex of
   582	    the independent member/delta interval box. Enumeration is deliberately
   583	    capped: callers must refuse rather than substitute an approximation once
   584	    the governed exact calculation is too large.
   585	    """
   586	
   587	    if len(point_values_j) != len(half_widths_j):
   588	        raise ValueError("admissible-set half-width count must match point estimates")
   589	    if not any(half_widths_j):
   590	        mean = sum(point_values_j) / len(point_values_j)
   591	        deviations = (
   592	            [value - mean for value in point_values_j]
   593	            if kind == "absolute"
   594	            else list(point_values_j)
   595	        )
   596	        prediction_extra = 0.0 if kind == "absolute" else abs(mean)
   597	        return _floor_estimate(
   598	            kind, deviations, mean, prediction_extra
   599	        ).unguarded_floor_j
   600	    if len(point_values_j) > MAX_EXACT_ADMISSIBLE_CORNER_N:
   601	        raise ValueError(
   602	            "exact admissible-set corner enumeration is capped at "
   603	            f"n={MAX_EXACT_ADMISSIBLE_CORNER_N}"
   604	        )
   605	
   606	    maximum = 0.0
   607	    for mask in range(1 << len(point_values_j)):
   608	        corner = [
   609	            point + (width if mask & (1 << index) else -width)
   610	            for index, (point, width) in enumerate(
   611	                zip(point_values_j, half_widths_j, strict=True)
   612	            )
   613	        ]
   614	        mean = sum(corner) / len(corner)
   615	        deviations = (
   616	            [value - mean for value in corner]
   617	            if kind == "absolute"
   618	            else corner
   619	        )
   620	        prediction_extra = 0.0 if kind == "absolute" else abs(mean)
   621	        maximum = max(
   622	            maximum,
   623	            _floor_estimate(
   624	                kind, deviations, mean, prediction_extra
   625	            ).unguarded_floor_j,
   626	        )
   627	    return maximum
   628	
   629	
   630	def absolute_false_effect_floor(
   631	    values_j: Sequence[float],
   632	    *,
   633	    admissible_half_widths_j: Sequence[float],
   634	) -> FloorEstimate:
   635	    """D-054 absolute floor, widened by member admissible-set uncertainty."""
   636	    values = _clean_values(values_j, "energies")
   637	    mean = sum(values) / len(values)
   638	    residuals = [v - mean for v in values]
   639	    estimate = _floor_estimate("absolute", residuals, mean, 0.0)
   640	    widths = _admissible_widths(
   641	        admissible_half_widths_j, expected_n=len(values)
   642	    )
   643	    n = len(values)
   644	    total_width = math.fsum(widths)
   645	    # For residual r_i = x_i - mean(x), the independent interval coefficients
   646	    # are (n-1)/n on member i and -1/n on every other member.  Linear extrema
   647	    # over a box occur exactly at corners, so this is an equality, not a bound.
   648	    residual_widths = [
   649	        width * (n - 1) / n + (total_width - width) / n
   650	        for width in widths
   651	    ]
   652	    # Keep the exact linear-residual result as a cheap lower bound, but the
   653	    # operative floor is the maximum of the COMPLETE D-054 floor at a joint
   654	    # interval-box corner. In particular, uncertainty can maximize the
   655	    # Student-t prediction component at a different corner.
   656	    uncertainty_floor = max(
   657	        _linear_corner_widened_max(residuals, residual_widths),
   658	        _corner_maximized_unguarded_floor(values, widths, kind="absolute"),
   659	    )
   660	    return _apply_admissible_set_guard(estimate, uncertainty_floor, widths)
   661

  1456	def _admissible_energy_set(value: Any) -> tuple[float, float, float] | None:

  1458	        return None
  1459	    fields = (
  1460	        _finite_number(value.get("point_j"), positive=True),
  1461	        _finite_number(value.get("lower_j"), positive=True),
  1462	        _finite_number(value.get("upper_j"), positive=True),
  1463	    )
  1464	    if any(item is None for item in fields):
  1465	        return None
  1466	    point, lower, upper = (float(item) for item in fields)
  1467	    return (point, lower, upper) if lower <= point <= upper else None

  1478	def _endpoint_point_summary(values: Sequence[Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
  1479	    points = [_finite_number(value) for value in values]
  1480	    if not points or any(point is None for point in points):
  1481	        return None
  1482	    normalized = [float(point) for point in points]
  1483	    return {
  1484	        "n": len(normalized),
  1485	        "mean_j": statistics.fmean(normalized),
  1486	        "standard_error_j": (
  1487	            statistics.stdev(normalized) / math.sqrt(len(normalized))
  1488	            if len(normalized) > 1
  1489	            else None
  1490	        ),
  1491	        "member_points_j": normalized,
  1492	    }

  1495	def _endpoint_admissible_summary(values: Sequence[Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
  1496	    sets = [_admissible_energy_set(value) for value in values]
  1497	    if not sets or any(item is None for item in sets):
  1498	        return None
  1499	    normalized = [item for item in sets if item is not None]
  1500	    points = [item[0] for item in normalized]
  1501	    return {
  1502	        "n": len(normalized),
  1503	        "mean_j": statistics.fmean(points),
  1504	        "standard_error_j": (
  1505	            statistics.stdev(points) / math.sqrt(len(points))
  1506	            if len(points) > 1
  1507	            else None

  1509	        "member_points_j": points,
  1510	        "mean_admissible_set_j": {

  1512	            "lower_j": statistics.fmean(item[1] for item in normalized),
  1513	            "upper_j": statistics.fmean(item[2] for item in normalized),

  1554	def _family_drift_record(

  1576	        "claim_family": family,
  1577	        "endpoint_protocol": protocol,
  1578	        "start": dict(start),
  1579	        "midpoint": dict(midpoint) if midpoint is not None else None,
  1580	        "end": dict(end),

  1592	        "screen_statistic_definition": "abs(end_endpoint_mean-start_endpoint_mean)",

  1594	        "screen_passed": (

  1598	        ),
  1599	        "trajectory_excursion_max_j": excursion,

  3940	                power_source=environment.get("power_source"),

  3942	        )

  3953	            observations.append(

  3961	        observations.append(
  3962	            extract_adapter_observation(
  3963	                post.get("power") if isinstance(post.get("power"), dict) else None,
  3964	                source=f"{evaluation.bundle_id}:post_run",
  3965	                power_source=post.get("power_source"),
  3966	            )
  3967	        )

  3971	        # not be hidden by clean pre-run samples.

  3973	            extract_adapter_observation(
  3974	                None,
  3975	                source=f"{evaluation.bundle_id}:post_run_missing",
  3976	            )
  3977	        )

  3981	def _gross_energy_for(evaluation: MemberEvaluation) -> dict[str, float] | None:
  3982	    if not evaluation.usable or evaluation.validation_problems:
  3983	        return None
  3984	    summary = evaluation.summary
  3985	    value = summary.get("gross_energy_j") if isinstance(summary, dict) else None
  3986	    if (
  3987	        isinstance(value, bool)
  3988	        or not isinstance(value, int | float)
  3989	        or not math.isfinite(float(value))
  3990	    ):
  3991	        return None
  3992	    envelopes = summary.get("energy_anchor_shift_envelopes")
  3993	    envelope = envelopes.get("/gross_energy_j") if isinstance(envelopes, dict) else None
  3994	    if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
  3995	        # NEG-8 is a causal-set comparison.  A point without its admitted set
  3996	        # cannot establish drift stability and therefore refuses downstream.
  3997	        return None
  3998	    fields = (envelope.get("point_j"), envelope.get("lower_j"), envelope.get("upper_j"))
  3999	    if any(
  4000	        isinstance(item, bool)
  4001	        or not isinstance(item, int | float)
  4002	        or not math.isfinite(float(item))
  4003	        for item in fields
  4004	    ):
  4005	        return None
  4006	    point, lower, upper = (float(item) for item in fields)
  4007	    if not math.isclose(point, float(value), rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12):
  4008	        return None
  4009	    if lower <= 0.0 or not lower <= point <= upper:
  4010	        return None
  4011	    return {"point_j": point, "lower_j": lower, "upper_j": upper}
  4012

  4094	def idle_admission_core_verdict(
  4095	    evaluations: Sequence[MemberEvaluation],
  4096	    policy_binding: CampaignPolicyBinding,
  4097	    *,
  4098	    whole_window: bool = False,
  4099	    runs_root: Path | None = None,
  4100	    neg8_drift_bound: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
  4101	    evaluation_timestamp_s: float | None = None,
  4102	    calibration_ledger_snapshot: CalibrationLedgerSnapshot | None = None,
  4103	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  4104	    """Post-hoc T0.5 idle-admission core surface for the campaign verdict.
  4105	
  4106	    Everything here is recorded data with stable named conditions; the
  4107	    collection verdict and exit code are unchanged by this section.  Live
  4108	    (pre-invoke) enforcement belongs to the controller hookup that follows
  4109	    this core.
  4110	    """
  4111

  4113	    section: dict[str, Any] = {
  4114	        "schema_version": IDLE_ADMISSION_CORE_SCHEMA,
  4115	        "policy_sha256": policy_binding.sha256,
  4116	        "extension": None,
  4117	        "members": [],
  4118	        "adapter_wattage_continuity": None,
  4119	        "neg8_bracket": None,
  4120	        "instrument_calibration_bracket": None,
  4121	        "conditions": [],
  4122	    }
  4123	    if extension is None:
  4124	        # Named condition, not an abort: pre-extension sidecars remain
  4125	        # valid, but the verdict says the CPU-aware admission never ran.
  4126	        section["conditions"] = ["idle_admission_extension_unconfigured"]
  4127	        return section
  4128	    section["extension"] = {
  4129	        "schema_version": extension.schema_version,
  4130	        "policy_version": extension.policy_version,
  4131	        "claim_bearing": extension.claim_bearing,
  4132	        "sha256": extension.sha256(),
  4133	    }
  4134	    conditions: set[str] = set()
  4135	    adapter_observations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  4136	    neg8_references: dict[
  4137	        str,
  4138	        list[
  4139	            tuple[
  4140	                dict[str, float] | None,
  4141	                float | None,
  4142	                str | None,
  4143	                tuple[float, float] | None,
  4144	                Mapping[str, Any] | None,
  4145	            ]
  4146	        ],
  4147	    ] = {"start": [], "midpoint": [], "end": []}
  4148	    for evaluation in evaluations:
  4149	        current_environment_reasons = _current_member_environment_refusals(evaluation)
  4150	        conditions.update(current_environment_reasons)
  4151	        if isinstance(evaluation.metadata, dict):
  4152	            adapters = evaluation.metadata.get("adapters")
  4153	            telemetry = (
  4154	                adapters.get("telemetry") if isinstance(adapters, dict) else None
  4155	            )
  4156	            telemetry_name = (
  4157	                telemetry.get("name") if isinstance(telemetry, dict) else None
  4158	            )
  4159	            if telemetry_name != "mock" and not current_environment_reasons:
  4160	                conditions.update(
  4161	                    post_run_environment_refusals(evaluation.metadata)
  4162	                )
  4163	        attempt = _final_idle_admission_attempt(evaluation)
  4164	        if attempt is None:
  4165	            conditions.add("idle_admission_attempt_ledger_invalid")
  4166	        records = (
  4167	            _load_idle_rich_telemetry(evaluation.bundle_path, attempt)
  4168	            if attempt is not None
  4169	            else None
  4170	        )
  4171	        cpu_admission = evaluate_cpu_idle_admission(
  4172	            records,
  4173	            extension.cpu_criteria,
  4174	            gpu_admitted=_gpu_admission_outcome(evaluation),
  4175	        )
  4176	        conditions.update(cpu_admission["conditions"])
  4177	        member_observations = _adapter_observations_for(evaluation)
  4178	        adapter_observations.extend(member_observations)
  4179	        section["members"].append(
  4180	            {
  4181	                "bundle_id": evaluation.bundle_id,
  4182	                "cpu_admission": cpu_admission,
  4183	                "adapter_observation_count": len(member_observations),
  4184	            }
  4185	        )
  4186	        neg8_position = _declared_neg8_reference_position(
  4187	            evaluation.declared_role, evaluation.sentinel_position
  4188	        )
  4189	        if neg8_position == "invalid":
  4190	            conditions.add("neg8_bracket_reference_invalid")
  4191	        elif neg8_position in neg8_references:
  4192	            neg8_references[neg8_position].append(
  4193	                (
  4194	                    _gross_energy_for(evaluation),
  4195	                    _idle_subtracted_energy_for(evaluation),
  4196	                    _neg8_reference_scientific_config_sha256(evaluation),
  4197	                    _reference_window_span(evaluation),
  4198	                    evaluation.metadata,
  4199	                )
  4200	            )
  4201	    continuity = evaluate_adapter_wattage_continuity(
  4202	        adapter_observations, extension.adapter_wattage
  4203	    )
  4204	    conditions.update(continuity["conditions"])
  4205	    # The NEG-8 bracket is a whole-window drift check: the canonical Window-A
  4206	    # sequence runs the start and end references as SEPARATE run_campaign
  4207	    # invocations, so the comparison is only sound when BOTH reference bundles
  4208	    # are evaluated together.  A per-segment invocation records the non-drift
  4209	    # ``neg8_bracket_not_evaluated`` condition rather than a spurious
  4210	    # ``failed``/``missing``.  In explicit whole-window mode a genuinely absent
    20	    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "configs" / "campaign_policies"
    21	)

    24	def environment_observation_failure(observation: Any) -> str | None:
    25	    """Apply the controller's display/screensaver failure predicate."""
    26	
    27	    if not isinstance(observation, Mapping):
    28	        return "environment guard observation is missing"
    29	    display_state = observation.get("display_power_state")
    30	    screensaver = observation.get("screensaver_engaged")
    31	    if display_state == "any_awake":
    32	        return "display became or remained awake during idle admission"
    33	    if screensaver is True:
    34	        return "screensaver became or remained engaged during idle admission"
    35	    if display_state != "all_asleep":
    36	        return "display power state is unknown during idle admission"
    37	    if screensaver is not False:
    38	        return "screensaver engagement state is unknown during idle admission"
    39	    return None

    61	def _finite_number(value: Any) -> float | None:
    62	    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int | float):
    63	        return None
    64	    converted = float(value)
    65	    return converted if math.isfinite(converted) else None

    68	def _attempt_capture_interval(
    69	    bundle_path: Path, attempt: int
    70	) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
    71	    """Read the producer's endpoint-stamped idle telemetry interval."""
    72	
    73	    name = (
    74	        "rich_telemetry_idle.jsonl"
    75	        if attempt == 1
    76	        else f"rich_telemetry_idle_attempt_{attempt}.jsonl"
    77	    )
    78	    try:
    79	        lines = (Path(bundle_path) / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    80	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
    81	        return None
    82	    starts: list[float] = []
    83	    ends: list[float] = []
    84	    for line in lines:
    85	        if not line.strip():
    86	            continue
    87	        try:
    88	            row = json.loads(line)
    89	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
    90	            return None
    91	        if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
    92	            return None
    93	        timestamp_s = _finite_number(row.get("timestamp_s"))
    94	        elapsed_ns = row.get("elapsed_ns")
    95	        if (
    96	            timestamp_s is None
    97	            or isinstance(elapsed_ns, bool)
    98	            or not isinstance(elapsed_ns, int)
    99	            or elapsed_ns <= 0
   100	        ):
   101	            # Current strict evidence must bind the capture to its stage.
   102	            # Untimestamped legacy diagnostics remain replayable because
   103	            # frozen consumers never dispatch to this validator.
   104	            return None
   105	        elapsed_s = elapsed_ns / 1_000_000_000.0
   106	        # Powermetrics rich telemetry stamps each averaging interval at its
   107	        # endpoint; this matches ``samples_from_records`` and the adapter's
   108	        # committed ``[endpoint-elapsed, endpoint)`` association rule.
   109	        starts.append(timestamp_s - elapsed_s)
   110	        ends.append(timestamp_s)
   111	    if not starts:
   112	        return None
   113	    return min(starts), max(ends)
   114

   116	def current_environment_refusals(
   117	    metadata: Any,
   118	    *,
   119	    bundle_path: Path,
   120	    measured_window_start_s: Any,
   121	    measured_window_end_s: Any,
   122	) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   123	    """Current-mint causal and cross-field environment evidence validator.
   124	
   125	    Callers must dispatch here only for strict 0.5.2/0.6.2 claim paths.  The
   126	    frozen replay arms intentionally retain their committed validator surface.
   127	    """
   128	
   129	    admission = metadata.get("environment_admission") if isinstance(metadata, Mapping) else None
   130	    reasons = set(
   131	        environment_admission_refusals(admission, require_attempt_timing=True)
   132	    )
   133	    reasons.update(_recomputed_environment_evaluation_refusals(metadata))
   134	    start_s = _finite_number(measured_window_start_s)
   135	    end_s = _finite_number(measured_window_end_s)
   136	    if start_s is None or end_s is None or start_s >= end_s:
   137	        reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   138	        return tuple(sorted(reasons))
   139	
   140	    attempts = admission.get("attempts") if isinstance(admission, Mapping) else None
   141	    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or not attempts:
   142	        reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   143	    else:
   144	        final_end_s = _finite_number(
   145	            attempts[-1].get("end_s") if isinstance(attempts[-1], Mapping) else None
   146	        )
   147	        if (
   148	            final_end_s is None
   149	            or final_end_s > start_s
   150	            or start_s - final_end_s > MAX_ADMISSION_GAP_S
   151	        ):
   152	            reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   153	
   154	        for expected_attempt, row in enumerate(attempts, start=1):
   155	            if not isinstance(row, Mapping):
   156	                reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   157	                continue
   158	            attempt_start_s = _finite_number(row.get("start_s"))
   159	            attempt_end_s = _finite_number(row.get("end_s"))
   160	            baseline = row.get("baseline")
   161	            baseline_duration_s = (
   162	                _finite_number(baseline.get("duration_s"))
   163	                if isinstance(baseline, Mapping)
   164	                else None
   165	            )
   166	            if (
   167	                attempt_start_s is None
   168	                or attempt_end_s is None
   169	                or baseline_duration_s is None
   170	                or baseline_duration_s <= 0.0
   171	                or baseline_duration_s > attempt_end_s - attempt_start_s + 1e-9
   172	            ):
   173	                reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   174	                continue
   175	            capture = _attempt_capture_interval(bundle_path, expected_attempt)
   176	            if capture is None or (
   177	                capture[0] < attempt_start_s - 1e-9
   178	                or capture[1] > attempt_end_s + 1e-9
   179	            ):
   180	                reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   181	
   182	    environment = metadata.get("environment") if isinstance(metadata, Mapping) else None
   183	    observation = (
   184	        environment.get("post_run_observation")
   185	        if isinstance(environment, Mapping)
   186	        else None
   187	    )
   188	    captured_at_s = (
   189	        _finite_number(observation.get("captured_at_s"))
   190	        if isinstance(observation, Mapping)
   191	        else None
   192	    )
   193	    if captured_at_s is None or captured_at_s < end_s:
   194	        reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   195	    reasons.update(post_run_environment_refusals(metadata))
   196	    reasons.update(
   197	        _window_thermal_pressure_refusals(
   198	            metadata,
   199	            bundle_path=Path(bundle_path),
   200	            measured_window_start_s=start_s,
   201	            measured_window_end_s=end_s,
   202	        )
   203	    )
   204	    return tuple(sorted(reasons))
   205

   209	    expected = binding.get("sha256") if isinstance(binding, Mapping) else None
   210	    if not isinstance(expected, str) or len(expected) != 64:
   380	    return ("environment_admission_missing",)

   383	def environment_admission_refusals(
   384	    admission: Any, *, require_attempt_timing: bool = False
   385	) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   386	    """Validate all claim-bearing admission evidence, failing closed."""
   387	
   388	    if not isinstance(admission, Mapping):
   389	        return ("environment_admission_missing",)
   390	    reasons: set[str] = set()
   391	    if admission.get("schema_version") != ADMISSION_SCHEMA:
   392	        reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   393	    if admission.get("critical_environment_passed") is not True:
   394	        reasons.add("environment_admission_failed")
   395	    if admission.get("reference_provenance_present") is not True:
   396	        reasons.add("environment_admission_failed")
   397	    evaluation = admission.get("per_run_environment_evaluation")
   398	    if (
   399	        not isinstance(evaluation, Mapping)
   400	        or evaluation.get("schema_version") != EVALUATION_SCHEMA
   401	        or not isinstance(evaluation.get("snapshot_sha256"), str)
   402	        or len(evaluation.get("snapshot_sha256", "")) != 64
   403	    ):
   404	        reasons.add("environment_admission_missing")
   405	    elif evaluation.get("eligible") is not True:
   406	        reasons.add("environment_admission_failed")
   407	    attempts = admission.get("attempts")
   408	    if not isinstance(attempts, list) or not attempts:
   409	        return ("environment_admission_missing",)
   410	    previous_end_s: float | None = None
   411	    for index, row in enumerate(attempts, start=1):
   412	        if (
   413	            not isinstance(row, Mapping)
   414	            or isinstance(row.get("attempt"), bool)
   415	            or row.get("attempt") != index
   416	        ):
   417	            return ("environment_admission_missing",)
   418	        if require_attempt_timing:
   419	            start_s = row.get("start_s")
   420	            end_s = row.get("end_s")
   421	            if (
   422	                isinstance(start_s, bool)

   208	    binding = metadata.get("campaign_policy") if isinstance(metadata, Mapping) else None
   209	    expected = binding.get("sha256") if isinstance(binding, Mapping) else None
   210	    if not isinstance(expected, str) or len(expected) != 64:
   211	        return None
   212	    try:
   213	        candidates = sorted(REGISTERED_POLICY_DIR.glob("*.json"))
   214	    except OSError:
   215	        return None
   216	    for path in candidates:
   217	        try:
   218	            raw = path.read_bytes()
   219	        except OSError:
   220	            continue
   221	        if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
   222	            continue
   223	        try:
   224	            payload = json.loads(raw)
   225	            return CampaignPolicy.from_mapping(payload)
   226	        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, SchemaError, TypeError, ValueError):
   227	            return None
   228	    return None

  5691	def _idle_admission_claim_barrier_reasons(core: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
  5692	    """Map the advisory core surface onto claim-bearing refusal reasons."""
  5693	
  5694	    reasons: set[str] = set()
  5695	    conditions = core.get("conditions")
  5696	    if isinstance(conditions, list):
  5697	        for condition in (
  5698	            "environment_admission_failed",
  5699	            "instrument_calibration_bracket_missing",
  5700	            "instrument_calibration_mismatch",
  5701	            "instrument_calibration_stale",
  5702	            "thermal_pressure_elevated_in_window",
  5703	            "environment_admission_missing",
  5704	        ):
  5705	            if condition in conditions:
  5706	                reasons.add(condition)
  5707	    members = core.get("members")
  5708	    if not isinstance(members, list) or not members:
  5709	        reasons.add("cpu_admission_core_missing")
  5710	    elif any(
  5711	        not isinstance(member, Mapping)
  5712	        or not isinstance(member.get("cpu_admission"), Mapping)
  5713	        or member["cpu_admission"].get("decision") != "admitted"
  5714	        for member in members
  5715	    ):
  5716	        reasons.add("cpu_admission_core_failed")
  5717	    continuity = core.get("adapter_wattage_continuity")
  5718	    if not isinstance(continuity, Mapping):
  5719	        reasons.add("adapter_continuity_evidence_missing")
  5720	    elif continuity.get("decision") != "stable":
  5721	        reasons.add("adapter_continuity_failed")
  5722	    bracket = core.get("neg8_bracket")
  5723	    if not isinstance(bracket, Mapping) or bracket.get("decision") == "not_evaluated":
  5724	        reasons.add("whole_window_neg8_verdict_missing")
  5725	    elif bracket.get("decision") != "passed":
  5726	        reasons.add("whole_window_neg8_verdict_failed")
  5727	    return sorted(reasons)
  5728	
  5729	
  5730	def apply_idle_admission_claim_barrier(
  5731	    readiness: dict[str, Any], core: Mapping[str, Any], *, claim_bearing: bool
  5732	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  5733	    if not claim_bearing:
  5734	        return readiness
  5735	    reasons = _idle_admission_claim_barrier_reasons(core)
  5736	    if not reasons:
  5737	        return readiness
  5738	    result = dict(readiness)
  5739	    result["verdict"] = "not_ready_for_analysis"
  5740	    result["reasons"] = sorted(set(result.get("reasons", [])) | set(reasons))

   663	def comparative_false_effect_floor(
   664	    block_deltas_j: Sequence[float],
   665	    *,
   666	    admissible_half_widths_j: Sequence[float],
   667	) -> FloorEstimate:
   668	    """D-054 comparative false-effect floor over ABBA block deltas.
   669	
   670	    The prediction component includes ``abs(mean_delta)`` — deltas are never
   671	    re-centered before the floor is computed.
   672	    """
   673	    deltas = _clean_values(block_deltas_j, "block deltas")
   674	    mean = sum(deltas) / len(deltas)
   675	    estimate = _floor_estimate("comparative", deltas, mean, abs(mean))
   676	    widths = _admissible_widths(
   677	        admissible_half_widths_j, expected_n=len(deltas)
   678	    )
   679	    uncertainty_floor = max(
   680	        _linear_corner_widened_max(deltas, widths),
   681	        _corner_maximized_unguarded_floor(deltas, widths, kind="comparative"),
   682	    )
   683	    return _apply_admissible_set_guard(estimate, uncertainty_floor, widths)

   686	def abba_delta(a1_j: float, b1_j: float, b2_j: float, a2_j: float) -> float:
   687	    """Exact ABBA block delta ``(B1 + B2 - A1 - A2) / 2``; sign is B - A."""
   688	    members = _clean_values([a1_j, b1_j, b2_j, a2_j], "ABBA members")
   689	    a1, b1, b2, a2 = members
   690	    return (b1 + b2 - a1 - a2) / 2.0

  2038	def _safe_source_path(root: Path, text: Any) -> Path | None:
  2039	    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
  2040	        return None
  2041	    pure = PurePosixPath(text)
  2042	    if pure.is_absolute() or ".." in pure.parts:
  2043	        return None
  2044	    try:
  2045	        path = (root / Path(*pure.parts)).resolve()
  2046	        resolved_root = root.resolve()
  2047	    except (OSError, RuntimeError):
  2048	        return None
  2049	    if path == resolved_root or resolved_root not in path.parents:
  2050	        return None
  2051	    return path
  2052

  2054	def ordinary_present_bundle_paths(runs_root: Path, bundle_id: str) -> list[Path]:
  2055	    """Find canonical and moved-in-root copies of one ordinary bundle."""
  2056	
  2057	    root = Path(runs_root).resolve()
  2058	    result: list[Path] = []
  2059	    try:
  2060	        candidates = sorted(path for path in root.iterdir() if path.is_dir())
  2061	    except OSError:
  2062	        return result
  2063	    for path in candidates:
  2064	        if path.name == bundle_id:
  2065	            result.append(path)
  2066	            continue
  2067	        if not (path / "summary_metrics.json").is_file():
  2068	            continue
  2069	        config = _read_json_object(path / "config.json")
  2070	        run_id = config.get("run_id") if isinstance(config, Mapping) else None
  2071	        if (
  2072	            isinstance(run_id, str)
  2073	            and sanitize_id_component(run_id) == bundle_id
  2074	        ):
  2075	            result.append(path)
  2076	    return result

  2079	def _occurrence_descriptor_valid(
  2080	    value: Any, runs_root: Path, *, bundle_id: str
  2081	) -> bool:
  2082	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or value.get("bundle_id") != bundle_id:
  2083	        return False
  2084	    source = value.get("source_manifest")
  2085	    member_index = value.get("member_index")
  2086	    bundle_index = value.get("bundle_index")
  2087	    if (
  2088	        not isinstance(source, Mapping)
  2089	        or isinstance(member_index, bool)
  2090	        or not isinstance(member_index, int)
  2091	        or member_index < 0
  2092	        or isinstance(bundle_index, bool)
  2093	        or not isinstance(bundle_index, int)
  2094	        or bundle_index < 0
  2095	    ):
  2096	        return False
  2097	    path = _safe_source_path(runs_root, source.get("path"))
  2098	    expected_sha = source.get("sha256")
  2099	    try:
  2100	        raw = path.read_bytes() if path is not None else None
  2101	        manifest = json.loads(raw) if raw is not None else None
  2102	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
  2103	        return False
  2104	    if (
  2105	        raw is None
  2106	        or not isinstance(expected_sha, str)
  2107	        or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_sha
  2108	        or not isinstance(manifest, Mapping)
  2109	    ):
  2110	        return False
  2111	    members = manifest.get("members")
  2112	    if not isinstance(members, list) or member_index >= len(members):
  2113	        return False
  2114	    member = members[member_index]
  2115	    ids = member.get("bundle_ids") if isinstance(member, Mapping) else None
  2116	    return bool(
  2117	        isinstance(member, Mapping)
  2118	        and member.get("execution") in {"invoked", "existing"}
  2119	        and isinstance(ids, list)
  2120	        and bundle_index < len(ids)
  2121	        and ids[bundle_index] == bundle_id
  2122	    )

  2125	def validate_occurrence_supersession_entry(
  2126	    entry: Mapping[str, Any], runs_root: Path
  2127	) -> bool:
  2128	    """Validate an explicit operator supersession artifact from current bytes."""
  2129	
  2130	    root = Path(runs_root).resolve()
  2131	    bundle_id = entry.get("bundle_id")
  2132	    superseded = entry.get("superseded_occurrences")
  2133	    quarantine = entry.get("quarantine")
  2134	    if (
  2135	        entry.get("schema_version") != OCCURRENCE_SUPERSESSION_SCHEMA
  2136	        or entry.get("record_type") != "campaign_occurrence_supersession"
  2137	        or entry.get("runs_root") != str(root)
  2138	        or not isinstance(bundle_id, str)
  2139	        or not bundle_id
  2140	        or not isinstance(entry.get("reason"), str)
  2141	        or not entry["reason"].strip()
  2142	        or not isinstance(superseded, list)
  2143	        or not superseded
  2144	        or not isinstance(quarantine, Mapping)
  2145	        or entry.get("entry_sha256") != supersession_entry_sha256(entry)
  2146	    ):
  2147	        return False
  2148	    selected = entry.get("selected_occurrence")
  2149	    if not _occurrence_descriptor_valid(selected, root, bundle_id=bundle_id):
  2150	        return False
  2151	    if any(
  2152	        not _occurrence_descriptor_valid(value, root, bundle_id=bundle_id)
  2153	        for value in superseded
  2154	    ):
  2155	        return False
  2156	    occurrence_hashes = [canonical_sha256(value) for value in superseded]
  2157	    if (
  2158	        len(set(occurrence_hashes)) != len(occurrence_hashes)
  2159	        or canonical_sha256(selected) in occurrence_hashes
  2160	    ):
  2161	        return False
  2162	    canonical = root / bundle_id
  2163	    present = ordinary_present_bundle_paths(root, bundle_id)
  2164	    if present != [canonical] or not canonical.is_dir():
  2165	        return False
  2166	    quarantine_path_text = quarantine.get("path")
  2167	    if not isinstance(quarantine_path_text, str) or not quarantine_path_text:
  2168	        return False
  2169	    try:
  2170	        quarantine_path = Path(quarantine_path_text).resolve(strict=True)
  2171	    except (OSError, RuntimeError):
  2172	        return False
  2173	    if quarantine_path == root or root in quarantine_path.parents:
  2174	        return False
  2175	    for name, field in (
  2176	        ("config.json", "config_sha256"),
  2177	        ("metadata.json", "metadata_sha256"),
  2178	        ("summary_metrics.json", "summary_sha256"),
  2179	    ):
  2180	        expected = quarantine.get(field)
  2181	        try:
  2182	            raw = (quarantine_path / name).read_bytes()
  2183	        except OSError:
  2184	            return False
  2185	        if (
  2186	            not isinstance(expected, str)
  2187	            or len(expected) != 64
  2188	            or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected
  2189	        ):
  2190	            return False
  2191	    return True

  2194	def occurrence_descriptor_identity(
  2195	    value: Any,
  2196	) -> tuple[str, int, int] | None:
  2197	    """Reduce one occurrence descriptor to its manifest-position identity.
  2198	
  2199	    The triple is the only thing two joins can compare without re-reading
  2200	    manifests: the runs-root-relative source manifest path plus the member
  2201	    and bundle indices inside it.  Anything malformed returns ``None`` so
  2202	    callers fail closed rather than matching on a partial identity.
  2203	    """
  2204	
  2205	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
  2206	        return None
  2207	    source = value.get("source_manifest")
  2208	    path = source.get("path") if isinstance(source, Mapping) else None
  2209	    member_index = value.get("member_index")
  2210	    bundle_index = value.get("bundle_index")
  2211	    if (
  2212	        not isinstance(path, str)
  2213	        or not path
  2214	        or isinstance(member_index, bool)
  2215	        or not isinstance(member_index, int)
  2216	        or member_index < 0
  2217	        or isinstance(bundle_index, bool)
  2218	        or not isinstance(bundle_index, int)
  2219	        or bundle_index < 0
  2220	    ):
  2221	        return None
  2222	    return (path, member_index, bundle_index)

  2292	def supersession_selected_occurrence_identity(
  2293	    entries: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  2294	    bundle_id: str,
  2295	    declared: Sequence[tuple[str, int, int]],
  2296	) -> tuple[str, int, int] | None:
  2297	    """Name the selected occurrence when a record covers all declarations.
  2298	
  2299	    Duplicate occurrence records are ambiguous evidence by default, and that
  2300	    default is what stops outlier laundering.  The single licensed exception
  2301	    is an explicit operator supersession artifact -- hash-bound, reason-
  2302	    bearing, and naming the quarantined copy -- and it licenses nothing wider
  2303	    than the declarations it actually names.  The record must therefore
  2304	    account for every declared occurrence and name no occurrence that was not
  2305	    declared; a partial record, an extra record, two competing records, or a
  2306	    repeated declared identity all return ``None`` and leave the caller's
  2307	    existing refusal in place.  Whether emitted rows equal this declaration
  2308	    set is the owning join's responsibility.
  2309	    """
  2310	
  2311	    declared_key = sorted(declared)
  2312	    if len(declared_key) < 2 or len(set(declared_key)) != len(declared_key):
  2313	        return None
  2314	    candidates = [
  2315	        entry
  2316	        for entry in entries
  2317	        if isinstance(entry, Mapping) and entry.get("bundle_id") == bundle_id
  2318	    ]
  2319	    if len(candidates) != 1:
  2320	        return None
  2321	    entry = candidates[0]
  2322	    selected = occurrence_descriptor_identity(entry.get("selected_occurrence"))
  2323	    superseded_values = entry.get("superseded_occurrences")
  2324	    if selected is None or not isinstance(superseded_values, list):
  2325	        return None
  2326	    superseded = [
  2327	        occurrence_descriptor_identity(value) for value in superseded_values
  2328	    ]
  2329	    if any(value is None for value in superseded):
  2330	        return None
  2331	    named = sorted([selected, *(value for value in superseded if value)])
  2332	    if len(set(named)) != len(named) or named != declared_key:
  2333	        return None
  2334	    return selected

   291	def complete_bundle_sha256(path: Path) -> str:
   292	    """Hash every regular file in a completed calibration bundle.
   293	
   294	    Relative POSIX paths are sorted; each file contributes its byte SHA-256
   295	    and size. Symlinks and special files fail closed. Directory metadata and
   296	    absolute paths are excluded so relocating immutable bytes preserves their
   297	    identity.
   298	    """
   299	
   300	    root = Path(path)
   301	    if root.is_symlink() or not root.is_dir():
   302	        raise ValueError(f"calibration bundle is not a real directory: {root}")
   303	    records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
   304	    try:
   305	        candidates = sorted(
   306	            root.rglob("*"), key=lambda item: item.relative_to(root).as_posix()
   307	        )
   308	    except OSError as exc:
   309	        raise ValueError(f"cannot enumerate calibration bundle {root}: {exc}") from exc
   310	    for candidate in candidates:
   311	        try:
   312	            file_stat = candidate.lstat()
   313	            mode = file_stat.st_mode
   314	        except OSError as exc:
   315	            raise ValueError(
   316	                f"cannot inspect calibration bundle member {candidate}: {exc}"
   317	            ) from exc
   318	        if stat.S_ISDIR(mode):
   319	            continue
   320	        relative = candidate.relative_to(root).as_posix()
   321	        if not stat.S_ISREG(mode):
   322	            raise ValueError(
   323	                f"calibration bundle member is not a regular file: {relative}"
   324	            )
   325	        digest = hashlib.sha256()
   326	        try:
   327	            with candidate.open("rb") as handle:
   328	                for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
   329	                    digest.update(chunk)
   330	        except OSError as exc:
   331	            raise ValueError(
   332	                f"cannot read calibration bundle member {relative}: {exc}"
   333	            ) from exc
   334	        records.append(
   335	            {
   336	                "path": relative,
   337	                "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
   338	                "size_bytes": file_stat.st_size,
   339	            }
   340	        )
   341	    if not records:
   342	        raise ValueError(f"calibration bundle contains no regular files: {root}")
   343	    rendered = json.dumps(
   344	        records,
   345	        sort_keys=True,
   346	        separators=(",", ":"),
   347	        ensure_ascii=False,
   348	        allow_nan=False,
   349	    ).encode("utf-8")
   350	    return hashlib.sha256(
   351	        CALIBRATION_BUNDLE_HASH_DOMAIN.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + rendered
   352	    ).hexdigest()

     1	"""Shared campaign-provenance schema and authentication primitives.
     2	
     3	The v2 attestation is an anti-malformation discriminator: it proves that the
     4	campaign writer emitted a particular raw manifest snapshot.  It is not an
     5	anti-tamper signature; a coordinated rewrite of both the manifest and its
     6	external log can recreate the evidence.  Claim-path tamper resistance remains
     7	the separately rechecked source-manifest hashes carried by verdict provenance.
     8	
     9	The shared authentication predicate has two named aggregation policies.
    10	``load_authenticated_campaign_manifest`` performs pointwise dereference for a
    11	pinned-descriptor verifier.  ``load_authenticated_campaign_catalog`` performs
    12	all-or-nothing enumeration for consumers whose inputs are the complete catalog.
    13	"""

    53	def campaign_manifest_member_shape_valid(
    54	    member: object, schema_version: object
    55	) -> bool:
    56	    """Validate the execution/outcome wire shared by every catalog reader."""
    57	
    58	    if not isinstance(member, Mapping):
    59	        return False
    60	    execution = member.get("execution")
    61	    bundle_ids = member.get("bundle_ids")
    62	    if (
    63	        schema_version not in CAMPAIGN_PROVENANCE_SCHEMAS
    64	        or execution not in {"invoked", "existing", "blocked_before_invoke"}
    65	        or not isinstance(member.get("run_id"), str)
    66	        or not member["run_id"]
    67	        or not isinstance(bundle_ids, list)
    68	        or not bundle_ids
    69	        or any(
    70	            not isinstance(bundle_id, str) or not bundle_id
    71	            for bundle_id in bundle_ids
    72	        )
    73	    ):
    74	        return False

    80	            return member.get("outcome") in CAMPAIGN_PROVENANCE_OUTCOMES

   137	        return False
   138	    if text[index] == "0":
   139	        index += 1

  1304	def _quarantine_torn_campaign_tail(log_path: Path, tail: bytes) -> Path:
  1305	    stamp = utc_timestamp().replace("-", "").replace(":", "").replace(".", "")
  1306	    digest = hashlib.sha256(tail).hexdigest()[:12]
  1307	    sidecar = log_path.with_name(f"{log_path.name}.torn-{stamp}-{digest}")
  1308	    try:
  1309	        fd = os.open(sidecar, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
  1310	        try:
  1311	            written = os.write(fd, tail)
  1312	            if written != len(tail):
  1313	                raise OSError(
  1314	                    f"short torn-tail quarantine write: wrote {written} of {len(tail)} bytes"
  1315	                )
  1316	            os.fsync(fd)
  1317	        finally:
  1318	            os.close(fd)
  1319	    except BaseException as exc:
  1320	        print(
  1321	            f"warning: FAILED to preserve {len(tail)} torn campaign-log "
  1322	            f"bytes to {sidecar} ({exc!r}); append refused, log untouched",
  1323	            file=sys.stderr,
  1324	        )
  1325	        raise
  1326	    print(
  1327	        f"warning: preserved {len(tail)} torn campaign-log bytes at {sidecar}",
  1328	        file=sys.stderr,
  1329	    )
  1330	    return sidecar

  1333	def append_log(
  1334	    log_path: Path,
  1335	    row: dict[str, Any],
  1336	    *,
  1337	    lock_token: CampaignLockToken | None = None,
  1338	) -> None:
  1339	    """Durably append one JSONL row with one ``O_APPEND`` write.
  1340	
  1341	    A prior valid but unterminated row receives its separator in the same
  1342	    write.  A malformed unterminated tail is the one tolerated torn-tail
  1343	    artifact and is truncated before appending; earlier corruption refuses.
  1344	    """
  1345	
  1346	    if lock_token is None:
  1347	        raise RuntimeError("campaign log append requires a held campaign.lock")
  1348	    ownership = _validated_campaign_lock_ownership(lock_token)
  1349	    resolved_log_parent = Path(log_path).resolve(strict=False).parent
  1350	    if (
  1351	        resolved_log_parent != ownership.runs_root
  1352	        and os.path.lexists(resolved_log_parent / "campaign.lock")
  1353	    ):
  1354	        raise RuntimeError(
  1355	            "campaign log append cannot use a foreign lock token for lockable "
  1356	            f"root {resolved_log_parent}"
  1357	        )
  1358	    _require_external_campaign_log(log_path)
  1359	    _assert_ascii_mapping_keys(row)
  1360	    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  1361	    prefix = b""
  1362	    try:
  1363	        existing = log_path.read_bytes()
  1364	    except FileNotFoundError:
  1365	        existing = b""
  1366	    if existing:
  1367	        parsed, final_segment = parse_campaign_log_bytes(existing)
  1368	        if parsed is None:
  1369	            raise ValueError("campaign log contains non-final corruption")
  1370	        if not existing.endswith(b"\n"):
  1371	            tail_start = existing.rfind(b"\n") + 1
  1372	            if final_segment == "mapping":
  1373	                prefix = b"\n"
  1374	            else:
  1375	                _quarantine_torn_campaign_tail(log_path, existing[tail_start:])
  1376	                truncate_fd = os.open(log_path, os.O_WRONLY)
  1377	                try:
  1378	                    os.ftruncate(truncate_fd, tail_start)
  1379	                    os.fsync(truncate_fd)
  1380	                finally:
  1381	                    os.close(truncate_fd)
  1382	    payload = prefix + (json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
  1383	    fd = os.open(log_path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o644)
  1384	    try:
  1385	        written = os.write(fd, payload)
  1386	        if written != len(payload):
  1387	            raise OSError(
  1388	                f"short campaign-log append: wrote {written} of {len(payload)} bytes"
  1389	            )
  1390	        os.fsync(fd)
  1391	    finally:
  1392	        os.close(fd)

   806	
   807	    Construct via :meth:`create`; the writer immediately persists

   813	        self,
